sloka: तद्दृष्ट्वा विफलं कर्म राक्षसः पुनरेव तु ।पादपान्सुबहून्गृह्य शत्रुघ्नायासृजद्बली ।। ७.६९.९ ॥
transliteration: taddṛṣṭvā viphalaṁ karma rākṣasaḥ punareva tu ।pādapānsubahūngṛhya śatrughnāyāsṛjadbalī ।। 7.69.9 ॥

translations.english: Seeing that action prove fruitless, the powerful demon Lavana again seized very many trees and hurled them at Shatrughna.
